name: Recording Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Storytelling

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the inspiring stories power of the storytelling domain.

Remote Viewing (Su)

Starting at 6th level, you can use clairvoyance/clairaudience at will as a spell-like ability using your cleric level as the caster level. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to your cleric level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Domain Spells: 3rd–speak with dead, 4th–divination, 6th–analyze dweomer, 9th–foresight
